caption: Where can an AI model actually run?
Three places: someone else's server, your laptop, a borrowed GPU.
Cloud tiers are fast and free — until the daily limit.
Your laptop has no limit, but it is slow.
Kaggle lends you two GPUs, a few hours a week.
So you do not pick one. You put a router in front.
It tries them in order. Out of quota? The next one answers.
Private or work questions skip the cloud entirely.
None of this is new. Open tools, wired together.
Scripts and a guide, if you want to take it apart.
